## Problem or use case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve.

What is currently difficult, missing, or unnecessarily complicated?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

How would it work from the user's perspective?

## Why would this be useful?

Explain who would benefit from this feature and how it would improve Lullwire Relay.

Would it improve privacy, security, usability, accessibility, deployment, or reliability?

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered other ways to solve this problem?

Describe any existing workarounds or alternative approaches.

## Additional context

Include relevant examples, screenshots, technical details, or references that help explain your proposal.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for a similar request.
- [ ] This feature addresses a specific problem or use case.
- [ ] I understand that this is a proposal and may require further discussion.
